mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in the Federal Funds Rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the rate does not exceed 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint quarterly increases in GDP (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicate robust economic expansion, boosting market confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 and INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with CPIAUCSL below 2% and FEDFUNDS below 2%, markets anticipate sustained growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in this regime are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime conditions are not met.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly fall in UNRATE below 4.5% signals strengthening labor markets, enhancing corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE <4.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE create dual positive signals: monetary easing and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and labor market improvement
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in this interaction are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of expanding labor markets (PAYEMS up) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 up), markets anticipate sustained growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: expanding labor market with strong GDP growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in this regime are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime conditions are not met.
